title: 144 Spires Lane #401 - Vacation Rental in Gulf Place 30A,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…"144 Spires Lane #401", a serene condo in Santa Rosa Beach. Enjoy generous Gulf views from the private end-unit balcony, and a prime location just steps to the beach. With private beach access 2 minutes from your door, multiple resort-style community pools, and close proximity to shopping and dining at Gulf Place Town Center, this renovated 2-bedroom retreat is perfect for small families or couples seeking a tranquil 30A escape!*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Generous Gulf Views: Relax and take in breathtaking views from the private balconyPrivate Community Beach Access: Just a 2-minute walk to pristine Gulf watersCommunity Pools: A minute's walk to one of 3 community poolsPrime Location: Steps from Gulf Place shopping, dining, and entertainmentCulinary Ready: Updated kitchen with all the essentials for home-cooked mealsSpacious Comfort: Open concept living area and 2 cozy bedrooms for a peaceful retreatBeach Bikes: Includes 3 bikes for exploring the scenic 30A trail and nearby attractionsEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Beautiful view, clean, private, and fun! Easy beach access and a warm, clean pool made it the perfect vacation spot. Bike access was an added bonus. We’d love to return next winter!" – K.F.⭐ "Recently updated and just perfect! The view to the beach was amazing, and we enjoyed coffee every morning on the balcony. Everything was walking distance, and the beds were extremely comfortable!" – Karen M.⭐ "Calm and peaceful with a great ocean view. The beds were comfortable, and the short walk to the beach was a highlight. Gulf Place is fantastic, and the fourth floor offers an even better view!" – Christina H.*** LIVING AREA ***Open-Concept Living Area: Bright living area with large windows that flood the space with natural light and offer stunning Gulf viewsPlush Seating: Comfortable sofa and armchairs, perfect for relaxing after a day at the beachEntertainment Ready: Smart TV for streaming your favorite shows and moviesBalcony Access: Easy access to the large furnished balcony, where you can enjoy the Gulf breeze and breathtaking sunsets*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Fully Equipped Kitchen: Modern stainless steel appliances, perfect for preparing meals of any sizeAmple Counter Space: Includes a breakfast bar with seating for two, ideal for quick snacks or morning coffeeDining Area: Table that seats four, providing a cozy spot for family meals or game nightsStocked with Essentials: Includes cookware, utensils, and a coffee maker for your convenience*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Primary Bedroom: King bed with hotel-grade linens, Smart TV, and direct access to the private balcony. En-suite bathroom featuring a tub/shower comboQueen Guest Suite: Two Queen beds with cozy bedding, perfect for additional guests or kids. En-suite with an updated walk-in showerBunk Nook: Custom-built twin-over-twin bunk bed, offering a fun and practical sleeping arrangement for kids or extra guests*** COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***3 Community Pools: Including one just a minute's walk from the condo, perfect for relaxing or cooling offPrivate Beach Access: Just a 2-minute stroll to the pristine Gulf shoresBeach Bikes: 3 bikes for exploring the scenic 30A trail and nearby attractions*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Lively Beach Neighborhood: Located in the heart of the Gulf Place community, known for its vibrant atmosphereShopping and Dining: Steps to boutique shops, beach-inspired art galleries, and local dining favoritesEntertainment Options: Enjoy live music, an eclectic nightlife, and stand-up paddleboard rentals nearbyWalkable and Convenient: Everything you need is within walking distance, from the beach to unique shops and eateries*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 3 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesThe HOA does not provide areas to charge LSVs. Any rented LSVs must be gas-powered*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 207794
